notes.title: JET SET CORPS - Major Update 2025!
notes.content:
Major Update: Jet Set Corps – Enhanced Gameplay & New Features!
Prepare for the ultimate alien-fighting experience in Jet Set Corps with our latest Major Update! We've listened to your feedback and made improvements to deliver a smoother, more dynamic, and immersive adventure. The battle to save Earth has never been better—whether you're flying solo or teaming up in co-op mode.

What's New:
Improved Dynamic Movement: Glide, jump, and jet around with more fluid controls for a smoother and more responsive experience.

Steam Deck Compatibility: Enjoy the game anywhere with seamless Steam Deck support. Experience the same thrill of the Jetpack Marine on the go!

Enhanced Translations & Language Support: We've expanded language options to make sure players worldwide can join in the fight against the alien menace.

Gameplay Tweaks & Fixes: Based on player feedback, we've fine-tuned levels, improved AI behavior, and resolved various bugs, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable playthrough.

Switch Between Windows Seamlessly: Effortlessly switch between game window and system with a more intuitive and smoother transition, including a refined mouse cursor behavior.

Story Mode Outro: The adventure doesn't end with the last battle! Dive into a revamped outro that offers a satisfying and cinematic conclusion to your intergalactic journey.


What’s Next:

We're committed to continuously improving Jet Set Corps with more updates to come, ensuring the game is as exciting and polished as possible. Keep the feedback coming, and get ready to blast off into new adventures!

Join the Jet Set Corps today—Save Earth and the Galaxy!
